request.style: English, Male solo voice with warm choir, cello, flute, organ, harp, gentle choral mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I thought it needful now to send
My brother Epaphroditus back
A fellow worker and soldier friend
Your messenger for my need

[Verse]
He longed for you with heavy heart
Distressed by news of his illness
He lay in pain, his life apart
From breath and life in this world

[Verse]
Indeed he was ill near death
God showed mercy to him
And mercy to me from beneath
The weight of sorrow upon my mind

[Verse]
So I am eager to send him forth
That you may rejoice at sight
And ease the weight of my worth
Of sorrow lifted from the night

[Verse]
Welcome him in the Lord with joy
Hold such people in high honor
He faced death for Christ's employ
Risking life to help me more

[Outro]
He risked his life for the work of Christ
